own_solution.law: Maxwell speed distribution: fraction with v > v0 is F = erfc(x) + (2/sqrt(pi)) x exp(-x^2), x = v0/v_p, v_p = sqrt(2kT/m); amount = n F
assumptions: ideal monatomic gas in equilibrium at the wall temperature

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T2124 and TA645 say 'a modest amount' instead of the 17 K stated in the other temperature-rise sentences; if they are meant as variants of the 17 K sentences they differ in the number (harmless here since both are disconnected).

notes: With 17 K warming of the flask, the gas reaches 317 K: v_p = 1147.7 m/s, x = 1.7426, erfc = 0.01372, second term 0.09437, F = 0.10809, amount 0.0540 mol. Pressure (62 kPa) only fixes the volume via pV = nRT and does not enter the speed distribution. The u-to-kg conversion is not stated, but the standard value is implied. The window frame line is a pure distractor. TA78B uses past tense ('were measured'), which reads slightly oddly but means the same as TA6B3.
